text: Please don't call me arrogant, but I'm European champion and I think I'm a special one.

context.en: First press conference as Chelsea manager
context.es: Primera rueda de prensa como entrenador del Chelsea
context.pt: Primeira conferência de imprensa como treinador do Chelsea

text: I prefer not to speak. If I speak I will be in trouble.

context.en: Chelsea, asked about the referee after a 1-0 defeat at Aston Villa
context.es: Chelsea, preguntado por el árbitro tras perder 1-0 ante el Aston Villa
context.pt: Chelsea, questionado sobre o árbitro depois de perder 1-0 com o Aston Villa

text: He is a specialist in failure. I'm not.

context.en: On Arsène Wenger
context.es: Sobre Arsène Wenger
context.pt: Sobre Arsène Wenger

text: Three Premierships, and I won more Premierships alone than the other 19 managers together. … Respect, respect, respect.

context.en: Manchester United, walking out of the press conference after a 3-0 home defeat by Tottenham
context.es: Manchester United, al dejar la rueda de prensa tras perder 0-3 en casa ante el Tottenham
context.pt: Manchester United, ao sair da conferência de imprensa depois de perder 0-3 em casa com o Tottenham

text: Look, I'm a coach, I'm not Harry Potter.

context.en: Real Madrid, warning fans not to expect miracles after his first league match
context.es: Real Madrid, pidiendo a la afición que no esperara milagros tras su primer partido de Liga
context.pt: Real Madrid, a pedir aos adeptos que não esperassem milagres depois do primeiro jogo da Liga

text: Omelettes, eggs. No eggs, no omelettes. And it depends on the quality of the eggs.

context.en: Chelsea, on building a squad without new signings
context.es: Chelsea, sobre armar un equipo sin fichajes
context.pt: Chelsea, sobre construir uma equipa sem contratações

text: If I wanted to have an easy job I would have stayed at Porto – beautiful blue chair, the UEFA Champions League trophy, God, and after God, me.

context.en: Chelsea, explaining why he left Porto
context.es: Chelsea, explicando por qué dejó el Oporto
context.pt: Chelsea, a explicar porque deixou o FC Porto

text: Young players are like melons. Only when you open and taste the melon are you 100% sure that the melon is good.

context.en: On developing young players
context.es: Sobre la formación de jóvenes
context.pt: Sobre a formação de jovens

text: As we say in Portugal, they brought the bus and they left the bus in front of the goal.

context.en: After a 0-0 against Tottenham – the birth of 'parking the bus'
context.es: Tras un 0-0 ante el Tottenham: nace 'aparcar el autobús'
context.pt: Depois de um 0-0 com o Tottenham: nasce 'estacionar o autocarro'

text: It was the most beautiful defeat of my life.

context.en: Inter, after reaching the Champions League final at Camp Nou with ten men
context.es: Inter, tras clasificarse para la final de la Champions en el Camp Nou con diez
context.pt: Inter, depois de chegar à final da Champions em Camp Nou com dez jogadores

text: I'm the happy one.

context.en: On returning to Chelsea
context.es: En su regreso al Chelsea
context.pt: No regresso ao Chelsea

text: This is football from the 19th century.

context.en: Chelsea, on West Ham's defensive approach
context.es: Chelsea, sobre el planteamiento defensivo del West Ham
context.pt: Chelsea, sobre a abordagem defensiva do West Ham

text: I'm one of you.

context.en: To Chelsea fans, in his first interview after returning
context.es: A la afición del Chelsea, en su primera entrevista tras volver
context.pt: Aos adeptos do Chelsea, na primeira entrevista após o regresso

text: I understand why he is emotional. You would be sad if your team got dominated by opponents who have been built with 10 per cent of your budget.

context.en: FC Porto, on Sir Alex Ferguson after beating Manchester United in the Champions League
context.es: FC Porto, sobre Sir Alex Ferguson tras ganar al Manchester United en la Champions
context.pt: FC Porto, sobre Sir Alex Ferguson depois de vencer o Manchester United na Liga dos Campeões

text: I don't like intellectual prostitution, I like intellectual honesty. … We haven't talked about Milan, who will finish the season with zero titles.

original.text: A me non piace la prostituzione intellettuale, a me piace l'onestà intellettuale. … Non si è parlato del Milan che ha 11 punti meno di noi e chiuderà la stagione con zero titoli.

context.en: Inter, at a press conference after a row over a penalty against Roma
context.es: Inter, en rueda de prensa tras la polémica por un penalti ante la Roma
context.pt: Inter, em conferência de imprensa após a polémica de um penálti contra a Roma

text: At almost 70 years of age has won a Super Cup and another small cup. He is too old to change his mentality.

original.text: A quasi 70 anni ha vinto una Supercoppa e un'altra piccola Coppa. È troppo vecchio per cambiare mentalità.

context.en: Inter, replying to Juventus coach Claudio Ranieri
context.es: Inter, respondiendo al entrenador de la Juventus, Claudio Ranieri
context.pt: Inter, a responder ao treinador da Juventus, Claudio Ranieri

text: As for Lo Monaco, I do not know who he is. With the name Monaco, I have heard of Bayern Monaco (Munich) and the Monaco GP, the Tibetan Monaco (Monk) and the Principality of Monaco. I've never heard of any others.

original.text: Io conosco il monaco del Tibet, il Principato di Monaco, il Bayern Monaco, il Gran Prix di Monaco. Non ne conosco altri.

context.en: Inter, replying to Catania's chief executive Pietro Lo Monaco
context.es: Inter, respondiendo al consejero delegado del Catania, Pietro Lo Monaco
context.pt: Inter, a responder ao administrador do Catania, Pietro Lo Monaco

text: If I tell UEFA what I really think and feel, my career would end now. Instead, I will just ask a question to which I hope one day to get a response: Why? Why Ovrebo? Why Busacca? Why De Bleeckere? Why Stark? Why? Because every semi-final the same things happen.

context.en: Real Madrid, after the Champions League semi-final first-leg defeat by Barcelona
context.es: Real Madrid, tras perder la ida de la semifinal de la Champions ante el Barcelona
context.pt: Real Madrid, depois de perder a primeira mão da meia-final da Liga dos Campeões com o Barcelona

text: I think he is one of these people who is a voyeur. He likes to watch other people.

context.en: Chelsea, on Arsène Wenger's comments about the club
context.es: Chelsea, sobre los comentarios de Arsène Wenger acerca del club
context.pt: Chelsea, sobre os comentários de Arsène Wenger acerca do clube

text: I've sat in this chair twice before in the Champions League, and I knock Man Utd out at home twice, with Porto - Man Utd out, and with Real Madrid - Man Utd out. So this is nothing new for this football club.

context.en: Manchester United, after a Champions League exit to Sevilla at Old Trafford
context.es: Manchester United, tras caer eliminado de la Champions ante el Sevilla en Old Trafford
context.pt: Manchester United, depois da eliminação da Liga dos Campeões frente ao Sevilha em Old Trafford

text: Same coach, different players.

context.en: Tottenham, asked why his side kept losing leads
context.es: Tottenham, preguntado por qué su equipo perdía ventajas
context.pt: Tottenham, questionado sobre porque a equipa perdia vantagens

text: Now I am staying, there are no doubts. Even if some rumours emerge, I only want to remain at Roma.

context.en: Roma, after winning the Europa Conference League final
context.es: Roma, tras ganar la final de la Conference League
context.pt: Roma, depois de ganhar a final da Liga Conferência

text: This shirt is my skin.

context.en: Fenerbahçe, at his unveiling in Istanbul
context.es: Fenerbahçe, en su presentación en Estambul
context.pt: Fenerbahçe, na apresentação em Istambul
